.github/workflows/build-apk.yml
name: Build APK

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 21

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Show resolved library versions
        run: npm ls --depth=0

      - name: Add Android platform
        run: npx cap add android

      - name: Status bar icons follow day/night
        run: |
          R=android/app/src/main/res
          mkdir -p $R/values $R/values-night
          printf '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n<resources>\n    <bool name="work_light_bars">true</bool>\n</resources>\n' > $R/values/work_bool.xml
          printf '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n<resources>\n    <bool name="work_light_bars">false</bool>\n</resources>\n' > $R/values-night/work_bool.xml
          sed -i 's#\(<style name="AppTheme.NoActionBar"[^>]*>\)#\1\n        <item name="android:windowLightStatusBar">@bool/work_light_bars</item>\n        <item name="android:windowLightNavigationBar">@bool/work_light_bars</item>#' $R/values/styles.xml

      - name: App icons (2 styles x 8 colors, switchable)
        run: |
          pip install --break-system-packages pillow
          python3 android-src/gen_icons.py
          P=android/app/src/main/java/com/pd/earnings
          mkdir -p $P
          cp android-src/AppIconPlugin.java $P/

      - name: All-files backup plugin
        run: |
          P=android/app/src/main/java/com/pd/earnings
          mkdir -p $P
          cp android-src/AllFilesPlugin.java $P/

      - name: Fingerprint lock + home-screen widget
        run: |
          P=android/app/src/main/java/com/pd/earnings
          R=android/app/src/main/res
          mkdir -p $P $R/layout $R/drawable $R/xml
          cp android-src/BioPlugin.java $P/
          cp android-src/WorkWidgetProvider.java $P/
          cp android-src/TotalWidgetProvider.java $P/
          cp android-src/Shortcuts.java $P/
          cp android-src/WorkWidgetPlugin.java $P/
          cp android-src/ItemWidgetProvider.java $P/
          cp android-src/ComboWidgetProvider.java $P/
          cp android-src/MainActivity.java $P/
          cp android-src/WifiTracker.java $P/
          cp android-src/WifiWatchService.java $P/
          cp android-src/WifiBootReceiver.java $P/
          cp android-src/WifiTrackPlugin.java $P/
          cp android-src/work_widget.xml $R/layout/
          cp android-src/work_widget_bg.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_widget_bg_on.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_w_play.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_w_stop.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_w_check.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_widget_bg_glass.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_widget_bg_none.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_widget_bg_dark.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_w_play_s.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_w_stop_s.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_w_check_s.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_w_play_r.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_w_stop_r.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_w_check_r.xml $R/drawable/
          cp android-src/work_w_colors.xml $R/values/work_w_colors.xml
          cp android-src/work_w_colors_night.xml $R/values-night/work_w_colors.xml
          cp android-src/work_widget_info.xml $R/xml/
          cat > $R/layout/work_total_widget.xml <<'XMLEOF'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
              android:id="@+id/work_t_root"
              android:layout_width="match_parent"
              android:layout_height="match_parent"
              android:orientation="vertical"
              android:gravity="center"
              android:paddingStart="12dp"
              android:paddingEnd="12dp"
              android:paddingTop="6dp"
              android:paddingBottom="6dp"
              android:background="@drawable/work_widget_bg">
              <TextView
                  android:id="@+id/work_t_label"
                  android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                  android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                  android:maxLines="1"
                  android:textSize="12sp"
                  android:text="المجموع الكامل" />
              <TextView
                  android:id="@+id/work_t_value"
                  android:layout_width="match_parent"
                  android:layout_height="0dp"
                  android:layout_weight="1"
                  android:gravity="center"
                  android:maxLines="1"
                  android:textStyle="bold"
                  android:textDirection="ltr"
                  android:autoSizeTextType="uniform"
                  android:autoSizeMinTextSize="12sp"
                  android:autoSizeMaxTextSize="26sp"
                  android:text="" />
          </LinearLayout>
          XMLEOF
          cat > $R/xml/work_total_info.xml <<'XMLEOF'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <appwidget-provider xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
              android:minWidth="110dp"
              android:minHeight="40dp"
              android:targetCellWidth="2"
              android:targetCellHeight="1"
              android:updatePeriodMillis="0"
              android:initialLayout="@layout/work_total_widget"
              android:resizeMode="horizontal|vertical"
              android:widgetCategory="home_screen" />
          XMLEOF
          cat > $R/layout/work_item_widget.xml <<'XMLEOF'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
              android:id="@+id/work_i_root"
              android:layout_width="match_parent"
              android:layout_height="match_parent"
              android:orientation="vertical"
              android:gravity="center"
              android:padding="6dp"
              android:background="@drawable/work_widget_bg">
              <ImageView
                  android:id="@+id/work_i_icon_a"
                  android:layout_width="30dp"
                  android:layout_height="30dp"
                  android:tint="@color/work_w_fg"
                  android:src="@drawable/work_w_add" />
              <ImageView
                  android:id="@+id/work_i_icon_w"
                  android:layout_width="30dp"
                  android:layout_height="30dp"
                  android:tint="#FFFFFFFF"
              android:visibility="gone"
                  android:src="@drawable/work_w_add" />
              <ImageView
                  android:id="@+id/work_i_icon_k"
                  android:layout_width="30dp"
                  android:layout_height="30dp"
                  android:tint="#FF111111"
              android:visibility="gone"
                  android:src="@drawable/work_w_add" />
              <TextView
                  android:id="@+id/work_i_title_a"
                  android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                  android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                  android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                  android:maxLines="1"
                  android:textColor="@color/work_w_fg"
                  android:textSize="12sp"
                  android:text="عنصر" />
              <TextView
                  android:id="@+id/work_i_title_w"
                  android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                  android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                  android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                  android:maxLines="1"
                  android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                  android:textSize="12sp"
                  android:visibility="gone"
                  android:text="عنصر" />
              <TextView
                  android:id="@+id/work_i_title_k"
                  android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                  android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                  android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                  android:maxLines="1"
                  android:textColor="#FF111111"
                  android:textSize="12sp"
                  android:visibility="gone"
                  android:text="عنصر" />
          </LinearLayout>
          XMLEOF
          cat > $R/layout/work_combo_widget.xml <<'XMLEOF'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
              android:id="@+id/work_c_root"
              android:layout_width="match_parent"
              android:layout_height="match_parent"
              android:orientation="horizontal"
              android:layoutDirection="rtl"
              android:gravity="center"
              android:padding="1dp"
              android:background="@drawable/work_widget_bg">
              <LinearLayout
                  android:id="@+id/work_c_in"
                  android:layout_width="0dp"
                  android:layout_height="match_parent"
                  android:layout_weight="1"
                  android:orientation="vertical"
                  android:gravity="center"
                  android:padding="6dp">
                  <ImageView
                      android:id="@+id/work_c_in_a"
                      android:layout_width="30dp"
                      android:layout_height="30dp"
                      android:tint="@color/work_w_fg"
                      android:src="@drawable/work_w_play" />
                  <ImageView
                      android:id="@+id/work_c_in_w"
                      android:layout_width="30dp"
                      android:layout_height="30dp"
                      android:tint="#FFFFFFFF"
                      android:visibility="gone"
                      android:src="@drawable/work_w_play" />
                  <ImageView
                      android:id="@+id/work_c_in_k"
                      android:layout_width="30dp"
                      android:layout_height="30dp"
                      android:tint="#FF111111"
                      android:visibility="gone"
                      android:src="@drawable/work_w_play" />
                  <TextView
                      android:id="@+id/work_c_in_ta"
                      android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                      android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                      android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                      android:maxLines="1"
                      android:textColor="@color/work_w_fg"
                      android:textSize="12sp"
                      android:text="دخول" />
                  <TextView
                      android:id="@+id/work_c_in_tw"
                      android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                      android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                      android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                      android:maxLines="1"
                      android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                      android:textSize="12sp"
                      android:visibility="gone"
                      android:text="دخول" />
                  <TextView
                      android:id="@+id/work_c_in_tk"
                      android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                      android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                      android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                      android:maxLines="1"
                      android:textColor="#FF111111"
                      android:textSize="12sp"
                      android:visibility="gone"
                      android:text="دخول" />
              </LinearLayout>
              <View
                  android:layout_width="1dp"
                  android:layout_height="40dp"
                  android:background="#33808080" />
              <LinearLayout
                  android:id="@+id/work_c_add"
                  android:layout_width="0dp"
                  android:layout_height="match_parent"
                  android:layout_weight="1"
                  android:orientation="vertical"
                  android:gravity="center"
                  android:padding="6dp">
                  <ImageView
                      android:id="@+id/work_c_add_a"
                      android:layout_width="30dp"
                      android:layout_height="30dp"
                      android:tint="@color/work_w_fg"
                      android:src="@drawable/work_w_add" />
                  <ImageView
                      android:id="@+id/work_c_add_w"
                      android:layout_width="30dp"
                      android:layout_height="30dp"
                      android:tint="#FFFFFFFF"
                      android:visibility="gone"
                      android:src="@drawable/work_w_add" />
                  <ImageView
                      android:id="@+id/work_c_add_k"
                      android:layout_width="30dp"
                      android:layout_height="30dp"
                      android:tint="#FF111111"
                      android:visibility="gone"
                      android:src="@drawable/work_w_add" />
                  <TextView
                      android:id="@+id/work_c_add_ta"
                      android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                      android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                      android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                      android:maxLines="1"
                      android:textColor="@color/work_w_fg"
                      android:textSize="12sp"
                      android:text="عنصر" />
                  <TextView
                      android:id="@+id/work_c_add_tw"
                      android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                      android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                      android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                      android:maxLines="1"
                      android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                      android:textSize="12sp"
                      android:visibility="gone"
                      android:text="عنصر" />
                  <TextView
                      android:id="@+id/work_c_add_tk"
                      android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                      android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                      android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
                      android:maxLines="1"
                      android:textColor="#FF111111"
                      android:textSize="12sp"
                      android:visibility="gone"
                      android:text="عنصر" />
              </LinearLayout>
          </LinearLayout>
          XMLEOF
          cat > $R/drawable/work_w_add.xml <<'XMLEOF'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <vector xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
              android:width="24dp" android:height="24dp" android:viewportWidth="24" android:viewportHeight="24">
              <path android:strokeColor="#FFFFFFFF" android:strokeWidth="2.4" android:strokeLineCap="round" android:pathData="M12,5V19M5,12H19" />
          </vector>
          XMLEOF
          cat > $R/drawable/work_c_half_on.xml <<'XMLEOF'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <shape xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" android:shape="rectangle">
              <solid android:color="#F2C2791C" />
              <corners android:topRightRadius="27dp" android:bottomRightRadius="27dp" android:topLeftRadius="0dp" android:bottomLeftRadius="0dp" />
          </shape>
          XMLEOF
          cat > $R/xml/work_item_info.xml <<'XMLEOF'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <appwidget-provider xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
              android:minWidth="40dp"
              android:minHeight="40dp"
              android:targetCellWidth="1"
              android:targetCellHeight="1"
              android:updatePeriodMillis="0"
              android:initialLayout="@layout/work_item_widget"
              android:resizeMode="horizontal|vertical"
              android:widgetCategory="home_screen" />
          XMLEOF
          cat > $R/xml/work_combo_info.xml <<'XMLEOF'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <appwidget-provider xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
              android:minWidth="110dp"
              android:minHeight="40dp"
              android:targetCellWidth="2"
              android:targetCellHeight="1"
              android:updatePeriodMillis="0"
              android:initialLayout="@layout/work_combo_widget"
              android:resizeMode="horizontal|vertical"
              android:widgetCategory="home_screen" />
          XMLEOF
          M=android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml
          sed -i 's#</application>#    <receiver android:name=".WorkWidgetProvider" android:exported="true"><intent-filter><action android:name="android.appwidget.action.APPWIDGET_UPDATE"/></intent-filter><meta-data android:name="android.appwidget.provider" android:resource="@xml/work_widget_info"/></receiver>\n    </application>#' $M
          sed -i 's#</application>#    <receiver android:name=".TotalWidgetProvider" android:label="المجموع" android:exported="true"><intent-filter><action android:name="android.appwidget.action.APPWIDGET_UPDATE"/></intent-filter><meta-data android:name="android.appwidget.provider" android:resource="@xml/work_total_info"/></receiver>\n    </application>#' $M
          sed -i 's#</application>#    <service android:name=".WifiWatchService" android:exported="false" android:foregroundServiceType="specialUse"><property android:name="android.app.PROPERTY_SPECIAL_USE_FGS_SUBTYPE" android:value="wifi_presence_tracking"/></service>\n    <receiver android:name=".WifiBootReceiver" android:exported="false"><intent-filter><action android:name="android.intent.action.BOOT_COMPLETED"/><action android:name="android.intent.action.MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED"/><action android:name="com.pd.earnings.WIFI_WAKE"/></intent-filter></receiver>\n    </application>#' $M
          sed -i 's#</application>#    <receiver android:name=".ItemWidgetProvider" android:label="إضافة عنصر" android:exported="true"><intent-filter><action android:name="android.appwidget.action.APPWIDGET_UPDATE"/></intent-filter><meta-data android:name="android.appwidget.provider" android:resource="@xml/work_item_info"/></receiver>\n    </application>#' $M
          sed -i 's#</application>#    <receiver android:name=".ComboWidgetProvider" android:label="دخول وعنصر" android:exported="true"><intent-filter><action android:name="android.appwidget.action.APPWIDGET_UPDATE"/></intent-filter><meta-data android:name="android.appwidget.provider" android:resource="@xml/work_combo_info"/></receiver>\n    </application>#' $M
          grep -q 'WifiBootReceiver' $M || { echo "wifi receivers were not added to the manifest"; exit 1; }
          grep -q 'WifiWatchService' $M || { echo "wifi service was not added to the manifest"; exit 1; }
          grep -q 'WorkWidgetProvider' $M || { echo "widget receiver was not added to the manifest"; exit 1; }
          grep -q 'TotalWidgetProvider' $M || { echo "total widget receiver was not added to the manifest"; exit 1; }
          grep -q 'ItemWidgetProvider' $M || { echo "item widget receiver was not added to the manifest"; exit 1; }
          grep -q 'ComboWidgetProvider' $M || { echo "combo widget receiver was not added to the manifest"; exit 1; }
          sed -i '/^dependencies {/a\    implementation "androidx.biometric:biometric:1.1.0"' android/app/build.gradle
          grep -q 'androidx.biometric' android/app/build.gradle || { echo "biometric dependency was not added"; exit 1; }

      - name: Android 16 (API 36) + arm64 only + storage permissions
        run: |
          sed -i 's/targetSdkVersion = .*/targetSdkVersion = 36/' android/variables.gradle
          sed -i '/defaultConfig {/a\        ndk { abiFilters "arm64-v8a" }' android/app/build.gradle
          M=android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml
          sed -i 's#<application#<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" android:maxSdkVersion="32"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" android:maxSdkVersion="29"/>\n    <application#' $M
          sed -i 's#<application#<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.VIBRATE"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"/>\n    <application#' $M
          grep -q 'FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE' $M || { echo "wifi permissions were not added to the manifest"; exit 1; }
          grep -q 'MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE' $M || { echo "all-files permission was not added to the manifest"; exit 1; }
          sed -i 's#<application#<application android:requestLegacyExternalStorage="true"#' $M

      - name: Version number (changes with every build)
        env:
          N: ${{ github.run_number }}
        run: |
          G=android/app/build.gradle
          K=$((N - 69)); [ $K -lt 0 ] && K=0
          VN="$((5 + K / 100)).$((K / 10 % 10)).$((K % 10))"
          sed -i "s/versionCode [0-9][0-9]*/versionCode $N/; s/versionName \"[^\"]*\"/versionName \"$VN\"/" $G
          grep -q "versionCode $N$" $G || { echo "versionCode was not updated"; exit 1; }
          grep -q "versionName \"$VN\"" $G || { echo "versionName was not updated"; exit 1; }
          echo "VN=$VN" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "Version: $VN (code $N)"

      - name: Sync web assets
        run: npx cap sync android

      - name: Build release APK
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew assembleRelease

      - name: Sign APK
        env:
          KS_B64: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_B64 || secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 || secrets.KEYSTORE }}
          KS_PASS: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_PASSWORD || secrets.STORE_PASSWORD || secrets.KS_PASSWORD || 'workpass123' }}
          KEY_ALIAS_IN: ${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS || secrets.KEYSTORE_ALIAS || secrets.ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASS_IN: ${{ secrets.KEY_PASSWORD || secrets.KEYSTORE_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$KS_B64" ]; then
            echo "Keystore source: repository secret"
            echo "$KS_B64" | tr -d ' \r\n' | base64 -d > work.p12 || { echo "::error::The keystore secret is not valid base64"; exit 1; }
          else
            echo "::warning::No keystore secret found. Using a temporary key, so every update needs an uninstall first."
            keytool -genkeypair -keystore work.p12 -storetype pkcs12 -alias work -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -storepass "$KS_PASS" -keypass "$KS_PASS" -dname "CN=Work App"
            KEY_ALIAS_IN=work
            KEY_PASS_IN=
          fi
          BT=$(ls -d $ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/* | sort -V | tail -1)
          $BT/zipalign -f -p 4 android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk aligned.apk
          ARGS=(--ks work.p12 --ks-pass env:KS_PASS)
          if [ -n "$KEY_ALIAS_IN" ]; then ARGS+=(--ks-key-alias "$KEY_ALIAS_IN"); fi
          if [ -n "$KEY_PASS_IN" ]; then ARGS+=(--key-pass env:KEY_PASS_IN); fi
          $BT/apksigner sign "${ARGS[@]}" --out work-release.apk aligned.apk
          $BT/apksigner verify work-release.apk
          echo "Signed OK"

      - name: Name the APK by version
        run: mv work-release.apk "work-v$VN.apk"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: work-v${{ env.VN }}
          path: work-v${{ env.VN }}.apk
